Q631.reason: Positronium levels are half of hydrogen, so n=3 to n=1 emits 6.8*(8/9)=6.04 eV, closest to 6.0 eV; n=3 is not at the ionization limit.

Q722.reason: N true and Q false satisfy N·~Q; Q false makes ~O⊃Q true only when O is true; then ~N≡(O·P) forces P false, and that valuation satisfies all three.

Q625.reason: ‘~C unless D’ is ~D⊃~C, which is exactly ~C∨D; the negation on C is not absorbed by ‘unless.’
